test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option in the superlative degree that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

This is the __challenge__ task I have ever encountered.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. most challenging.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence uses the phrase **"challenge task,**" which is grammatically incorrect. The correct phrase should be** "challenging task."**
 
• The sentence is attempting to express the superlative degree, indicating the highest level of challenge encountered.
 
• The appropriate superlative form of "**challenging**" is "**most challenging**."
 
• Using **"most challenging"** correctly conveys that this task is the highest degree of challenge compared to all others encountered.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *This is the most challenging task I have ever encountered.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: more challenging**

 
 
• This is the comparative form of "challenging" and is used to compare two things. It is not suitable for expressing the highest degree among many.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: challenging**
 
 
• This is the base form of the adjective and does not convey any degree of comparison.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: much challenging**
 
 
• This phrase is grammatically incorrect as "much" is not used directly with adjectives in this manner. The correct usage would be "much more challenging."
